dct_description_sm:
URLs pointing to the most recent images taken by the corresponding camera. An example of the available URLs is below:
https://ww5.yorkmaps.ca/webtrafficimages/loc##.jpg
  • To find the camera feeds, replace “##” in the below URL with the location number of the desired camera. For camera numbers refer to the "Traffic Cameras" dataset also available on York Region's open data website.
  • Camera numbers range from 1 to 163.
The preview above is an example of a typical camera image. By opening the link and changing the "loc##" value in the URL other camera images can be accessed.
